csp.rationale: zero fs/shell/http/dialog plugin surface limits practical exposure; Tauri v2's IPC bootstrap script has its own nonce/CSP interaction that can only be safely verified against a real per-OS build/run, which this environment (Xvfb, no webview automation tooling) cannot exercise closely enough to validate a policy change blind. Re-evaluated and re-confirmed not release-blocking every phase since 3.0.

whisperModelPathHandling.pathTraversalRisk: none beyond the by-design ability for an operator to point CIP at any file they have read permission to

newCommandsThisPhase.getPilotDiagnostics: reads only already-configured state + Tauri's own monitor API; no new arbitrary-file-read surface
newCommandsThisPhase.backupDatabase: writes only via VACUUM INTO through the app's own already-open connection; never reads arbitrary files

sqlInjectionCheck.method: grep for format!-built SQL in persistence.rs
sqlInjectionCheck.result: no user-controlled string interpolated into a query; all values bound via rusqlite::params!

buildTimeGitCommand.note: build.rs invokes `git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD` at COMPILE time only (never at runtime) to embed a build identifier; falls back to 'unknown' if git or a checkout isn't available. This is a build-time-only exec, not a runtime exec surface.
